title: K01 Professional Technical Product Definition / Drawing Compiler
reason_for_rejection: automatic view/dimension import created repeated and poorly organized dimensions
visible dimensions contradict controlled release characteristics in the generated PDFs
title block and notes are incomplete for a production drawing
critical fits/GD&T are not consistently represented by native drawing annotations tied to the actual model features
drawing hierarchy does not reflect manufacturing and inspection sequence
source_methodology: Manual of Engineering Drawing — functional dimensioning, datum-based dimensioning, production drawing practice, positional tolerancing
Mechanical Tolerance Stackup and Analysis — functional dimensioning, worst-case stacks, assembly shift, datum/position relationships
compiler_pipeline: 2. Released native CAD + model feature map
5. Drawing Definition JSON: views, characteristics, native model dimensions, GD&T, hole/thread callouts, notes, inspection method
7. Native SOLIDWORKS drawing writer — views/sections/details only from Drawing Definition
8. Native annotations: Hole Callout / datums / feature control frames / surface-finish / weld/process symbols
10. Semantic cross-check: no contradictory duplicate dimensions; every release characteristic appears exactly once
12. Release PDF + SLDDRW + hash-bound Drawing Definition
implementation_rules: No engineering number may be hard-coded in HTML or drawing-layout code.
A dimension value comes from native model data or the controlled requirement/characteristic object.
For hole patterns use true/basic dimensions plus positional tolerance rather than chained coordinate dimensions when functionally appropriate.
Dimensioning shall follow the manufacturing datum/process sequence rather than expose every sketch radius.
Non-rigid/thin P007 shall have free-state/assembly-state requirements explicitly decided if needed.
A drawing generator may return HOLD_DRAWING_DEFINITION; it must never fabricate a tolerance to complete a sheet.
P003_release_view_strategy: primary longitudinal section through J2/service axis
detail view of pilot + O-ring gland if required for readable tolerances
no duplicated secondary orthographic view unless it conveys a unique manufacturing characteristic
P007_release_view_strategy: primary longitudinal section showing thin-can wall, locator depth and flange
J2 end view for clearance-hole pattern
explicit released OD/ID or wall-thickness tolerancing tied to structural/manufacturing evidence
next_action: Do not generate another production drawing until unresolved P003/P007 release characteristics are frozen and the Drawing Definition compiler is implemented.
